title: Pod Rescue
tagline: Patrol a settlement's sky: shoot the Thargoid Scouts snatching escape pods, and catch the pods before they fall.
description: A side-scrolling patrol round a whole settlement, with a scanner showing all of it. Thargoid Scouts come down and lift escape pods off the ground. Shoot one carrying a pod and the pod falls: catch it and set it down for a bonus, or it breaks if it falls too far. A pod carried off the top is lost, and its Scout comes back as a hunter. Lose every pod and the settlement is overrun. Shock mines clear the screen when it gets bad.
